desc:
MAC AND CHEESE: Gluten free mac and cheese with a yummy, real aged cheddar flavor

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Made with real cheese and no artificial flavors or synthetic colors

GLUTEN FREE RICE PASTA: Crafted with goodness in mind, this mac and cheese is made with great-tasting rice pasta

MICROWAVABLE CUPS: Simply add water, microwave, stir in cheese packet and enjoy

CONTAINS: One 8.04 oz pack of Annie's Gluten Free Microwavable Rice Pasta and Real Aged Cheddar Mac and Cheese; 4 cups
features:
Features:

Gluten-Free Rice Pasta: Made with a blend of white and brown rice flour, ideal for gluten-sensitive or celiac consumers.

Real Aged Cheddar Cheese: Contains real cheese from cows not treated with rBST, giving it an authentic, sharp flavor.

No Artificial Flavors, Colors, or Preservatives: Clean-label product made without synthetic additives.

Non-GMO Ingredients: Made without genetically modified organisms.

Microwave-Ready in 2 Minutes: Just add water, microwave, stir in cheese — quick and convenient.

Single-Serve Cup: Pre-portioned and portable, perfect for school, work, or travel.

Box Tops for Education Participant: Supports school fundraising through the Box Tops program.

Mild and Kid-Friendly: Designed to appeal to younger palates without being too strong or spicy.

Benefits:

Safe for Gluten-Free Diets: A delicious alternative to traditional mac & cheese for those avoiding gluten.

Quick & Easy Meal or Snack: No pots, strainers, or fuss — just microwave and enjoy.

Healthier Option: Clean ingredients with no artificial colors or preservatives, appealing to health-conscious consumers.

Tastes Like Classic Comfort Food: Creamy texture and cheesy flavor satisfy mac & cheese cravings.

Great for On-the-Go: Ideal for lunchboxes, dorm rooms, road trips, or emergency pantry meals.

Supports Education: Every cup can contribute to school fundraising efforts.

Loved by Kids and Adults: Family-friendly flavor profile makes it a go-to snack or meal
ingredients: Rice Pasta (white rice flour, brown rice flour), Dried Cheddar Cheese (cultured pasteurized milk, salt, non-animal enzymes), Tapioca Starch, Corn Starch, Butter (pasteurized cream, salt), Nonfat Milk, Salt, Coconut Oil, Whey, Organic Coconut Oil, Potassium Chloride, Sunflower Lecithin, Cultured Whole Milk, Annatto Extract (for color), Cultured Whey, Sodium Phosphate, Natural Flavor, Vinegar, Silicon Dioxide (for anticaking).
